decisions.question: C3 (queued for Wed Oct 28) names your Spiderman plank wrong. Swap it?
decisions.detail_html: In your videos and on SixPackAbs.com, a Spiderman plank is elbows up to a push-up position and back down. C3 calls that move a "plank up-down" and puts the Spiderman plank name on a knee-to-elbow move instead. C3 also uses 1:00 a move, which was a placeholder. Your real ab routine (toe touch, V-sit twist, Spiderman plank, 10 reps each, 3 rounds) is built below as 3 ab moves, 10 reps each. Here is C3 as queued:

decided: Every post gives the viewer something to use. Your own story only appears where it proves the point.

No mistake is faked. Where no footage of you doing it wrong exists, the slide is marked 'film at next shoot' and the post stays unticked until it is filmed (the ab wheel, gym arms and the deadlift swap).
Stomach vacuum was skipped for The Fix: you never filmed it done wrong, and your only 'mistake' line about it is about choosing crunches over vacuums.
One study was dropped (fasted cardio): only 20 young women for 4 weeks, and the raw numbers point the wrong way on a slide. 'Too old to build muscle' replaced it.
Receipts use 13 new AI images of food and objects only, all labelled. Every photo of you is real.

Your picks go into the Monday, Wednesday and Friday 5 PM image slots right after the first three (Oct 23, 26 and 28), alternating the three formats, best first. Then the old green studio posts come off the schedule into a reserve list.
